fixes: **The report filters are readable again.** Status, Role and the rest were rendered as a row of checkboxes with no spacing, labels running into the next box, wrapping across the form. Each filter is now a single button that opens a short list — and says what it is filtering on, so you can read the active filters without opening anything: "Status: Published", or "Status: 3 selected". Filters where only one answer is possible, such as Account status, stay an ordinary dropdown.

The underlying cause is fixed too: controls built while you use the page were relying on styling that is only assembled when the software is built, so it never reached them. They now carry their own. ---
